items.text: OpenAI's first Jony Ive-designed device is reportedly a hockey-puck-sized smart speaker priced between $300 and $400, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman.
items.text_zh: 据彭博社古尔曼爆料，OpenAI 与 Jony Ive 合作的首款硬件是一台冰球大小的智能音箱，售价预计在 300 至 400 美元之间。

items.text: OpenAI put Codex Security Review into research preview, having the agent inspect GitHub pull requests for security issues using full repository context.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 推出研究预览版 Codex Security Review，让智能体结合完整仓库上下文审查 GitHub 拉取请求中的安全问题。

items.text: ChatGPT can now call Adobe Photoshop and Lightroom directly, letting users retouch and design inside the chat without leaving the conversation.
items.text_zh: ChatGPT 现已可直接调用 Adobe Photoshop 与 Lightroom，用户无需离开对话即可完成修图与设计。

items.text: Moonshot AI's open-weight Kimi K3 became generally available in GitHub Copilot for agentic coding, hosted by Fireworks AI.
items.text_zh: 月之暗面开源权重模型 Kimi K3 正式在 GitHub Copilot 上线，面向智能体编程场景，由 Fireworks AI 提供托管。

items.text: Perplexity made GPT-5.6 Terra the default model for all Perplexity Computer subagents, saying it scores eleven points above Sonnet on WANDR.
items.text_zh: Perplexity 将 GPT-5.6 Terra 设为 Perplexity Computer 全部子智能体的默认模型，称其在 WANDR 上比 Sonnet 高出 11 分。

items.text: Cursor detailed its Router, which classifies requests and routes them across Grok 4.5, GPT-5.6 Sol and Opus 5 to cut latency and cost.
items.text_zh: Cursor 披露其 Router 工作原理：对请求分类后在 Grok 4.5、GPT-5.6 Sol 与 Opus 5 之间智能路由，以降低延迟和成本。

items.text: ElevenLabs shipped Dubbing v2 on its API, adding regional accent accuracy and letting enterprises bring their own transcripts and regenerate only edited segments.
items.text_zh: ElevenLabs 发布 API 版 Dubbing v2，提升地区口音还原度，并支持企业自带转录文本、仅重新生成被修改的片段。

items.text: Luma Labs added MiniMax H3 to Luma Agents, generating up to 15 seconds of 2K video with native stereo sound.
items.text_zh: Luma Labs 将 MiniMax H3 接入 Luma Agents，可生成最长 15 秒、2K 分辨率并自带立体声音频的视频。

items.text: Meshy upgraded Multi-View Image to 3D so textures are now generated from multiple reference views rather than a single one.
items.text_zh: Meshy 升级多视角图生 3D 功能，纹理现可基于多张参考视图生成，而非仅依赖单一视角。

items.text: Shanghai AI Lab open-sourced Mobius, an architecture it frames as upgrading knowledge connectivity the way Transformers upgraded token connectivity over RNNs.
items.text_zh: 上海人工智能实验室开源 Mobius 架构，称其对"知识连接性"的升级，类比于 Transformer 相对 RNN 在 token 连接性上的跃迁。

items.text: Unsloth released DSpark, which makes DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 GGUF builds generate roughly 1.4 to 2 times faster locally with no accuracy change.
items.text_zh: Unsloth 发布 DSpark，让 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 的 GGUF 版本在本地推理速度提升约 1.4 至 2 倍，且精度不变。

items.text: A community effort pointed coding agents at ICML 2026, with over 1,200 people reproducing more than 2,000 papers in the largest conference reproducibility audit yet.
items.text_zh: 一场社区行动把编程智能体对准 ICML 2026，1200 多人复现了逾 2000 篇论文，成为迄今规模最大的会议可复现性审计。

items.text: Genspark brought its open-source GenOffice suite to Linux, matching the existing Mac and Windows builds.
items.text_zh: Genspark 将开源办公套件 GenOffice 移植到 Linux，与已有的 Mac、Windows 版本保持一致。

items.text: Naïve raised $28.5 million to automate the administrative grunt work of incorporating and running a company.
items.text_zh: Naïve 融资 2850 万美元，用自动化处理公司注册与日常运营中的繁琐行政事务。
